claim_ceiling: This manifest defines 14 deterministic policy-level synthetic sensing scenarios. It contains no real acoustic waveforms, no propagation model validated against experiment, no published-paper reproduction and no robot qualification.

scenarios.name: Clean moving pass with informative echoes
conditions: known exact route and acoustic feature truth
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Independent chainage and feature truth must agree within frozen task tolerances; report acquisition and motion overhead.
scenarios.oracle_action_reason: The moving array is within its calibrated envelope and the oracle predicts an informative observation without a pause.

scenarios.name: Stationary direct acoustic stop-go baseline
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Preserve each stationary dwell and processing interval in total mission time; no pauses are omitted from the denominator.
scenarios.oracle_action_reason: This is the fixed stationary reference workflow; retain its entire dwell and processing cost.

scenarios.name: Moving-array phase compensation within envelope
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Accept only if phase/motion compensation revision and time alignment are exact and error is independently within tolerance.
scenarios.oracle_action_reason: Motion and phase compensation are within the declared supported envelope.

scenarios.name: Robot speed exceeds phase-compensation envelope
scenarios.oracle_requirement: The candidate must abstain or identify unsupported conditions; no high-confidence defect position is allowed.
scenarios.oracle_action_reason: Speed exceeds the calibration envelope; no supported phase correction is available.

scenarios.name: Repeated joints create overlapping acoustic aliases
perturbations: two echo hypotheses have similar likelihood
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Preserve multiple hypotheses; a single confident location is a false acceptance.
scenarios.oracle_action_reason: A safe independent viewpoint is the prescribed disambiguation action; retain multiple hypotheses until then.

scenarios.name: Excitation duration too short for target range
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Do not infer a precise absence or feature distance from an inadequate observation.
scenarios.oracle_action_reason: The current excitation is inadequate; select a longer signal only if its declared time and energy budget remains valid.

scenarios.name: Excitation duration too long for throughput budget
perturbations: stationary dwell or compute exceeds task budget
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Reject an action policy that exceeds frozen time/energy budgets without a sufficient decision-quality gain.
scenarios.oracle_action_reason: The longer excitation has negative net decision value under the frozen time budget.

scenarios.name: Channel dropout and array geometry drift
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Expose channel health and calibration incompatibility; do not claim nominal array observability.
scenarios.oracle_action_reason: Array geometry or channel integrity is not established; no nominal acoustic localization claim is admissible.

scenarios.name: Motor noise and vibration contamination
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Flag contamination or adapt only within a prequalified noise model; never silently accept corrupted samples.
scenarios.oracle_action_reason: Reduce motion-related contamination and reassess signal quality only within the calibrated speed/noise envelope.

scenarios.name: Water/debris and cable occupancy domain shift
scenarios.oracle_requirement: A model trained on a different pipe population cannot claim cable-duct localization without target-profile qualification.
scenarios.oracle_action_reason: The cable-duct occupancy and water/debris profile is outside the qualified population.

scenarios.name: Timebase mismatch between motion and acoustic channels
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Reject incompatible time alignment rather than silently correcting timestamps or fusing invalid observations.
scenarios.oracle_action_reason: Motion and acoustic timebases are incompatible; do not fuse misaligned observations.

scenarios.name: False feature association across a branch
perturbations: repeated echo appears on another branch
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Local feature detection may be retained, but branch/network association must be rejected unless independent anchor evidence supports it.
scenarios.oracle_action_reason: Branch association is unresolved and the available evidence does not establish a safe disambiguating route.

scenarios.name: No positive-value sensing action
perturbations: expected accuracy gain is smaller than time/energy/disruption cost
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Select continue or stop according to the frozen loss/cost policy; no action may be selected solely for higher signal-to-noise ratio.
scenarios.oracle_action_reason: No candidate measurement has positive net value after time, energy and disruption costs.

scenarios.name: Unobservable interval with no independent ground truth
perturbations: acoustic and visual measurements absent or unusable
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Preserve unobserved extent and refuse a precise feature or chainage claim across the interval.
scenarios.oracle_action_reason: The interval is unobserved and has no independent reference; preserve Indeterminate.

global_controls: The manifest is a deterministic policy-level plan, not an acoustic propagation simulation.
No published method is marked reproduced unless its source data/code and evaluation protocol are available and faithfully used.
Every failed, aborted, paused and manually recovered run remains in mission-time and energy denominators.
Feature distance/direction, robot chainage and pipe-condition classification remain distinct outputs.
No high-confidence location may be returned for a scenario whose independent oracle is ambiguous, unsupported or unobservable.
Task tolerance and budget are frozen before evaluating candidate sensing policies.
All results bind exact fixture, method, calibration, timing and configuration revisions.
